units.source_text: 在这期间，姨父升任了太宰大弍。

en.t: During this time, her uncle was promoted to Senior Assistant Governor-General of Dazaifu.

units.source_text: 夫妻两人安顿了女儿的婚嫁事宜之后，便欲赴筑紫的太宰府就任。

en.t: After the couple had settled their daughter's marriage arrangements, they planned to go to Dazaifu in Tsukushi to take up the post.

units.source_text: 他们还是巴望邀末摘花同去。

en.t: They still hoped to invite Suetsumuhana to go with them.

units.source_text: 叫人对她说：“我等即将离京远行了。

en.t: They sent someone to tell her, "We are about to leave the capital and travel far away.

units.source_text: 你独处寂寥，我等甚是挂念。

en.t: We are deeply concerned that you will be living alone in loneliness.

units.source_text: 年来我们虽未经常往来，只因近在咫尺，也就放心。

en.t: Although we have not visited often over the years, we felt at ease because you were so close by.

units.source_text: 但今后远赴他乡，实在怜惜你，放心不下，所以……”

en.t: But now that we are going far away to another province, we truly feel sorry for you and cannot stop worrying, and so..."

units.source_text: 措辞十分巧妙，但末摘花如同不闻。

en.t: The wording was very skillful, but Suetsumuhana acted as though she had not heard it.

units.source_text: 姨母生气了，骂道：“哼，真可恶，架子好大啊！

en.t: Her aunt grew angry and scolded her, "Hmph, how hateful, what airs you put on!

units.source_text: 任凭你多么骄傲，住在这蓬蒿丛中的人，源氏大将也不会看重的吧！”

en.t: No matter how proud you are, surely General Genji will not think much of someone living among these weeds and mugwort!"
